description: Set up FastAPI application with proper project structure
steps: Create src/prediction_data/api/ directory structure
Create main.py with FastAPI app, CORS middleware
Create deps.py for dependency injection
Add fastapi, uvicorn to pyproject.toml
Verify app starts with uvicorn

description: Add PostgreSQL for user data storage
steps: Add postgres service to docker-compose.yml
Add asyncpg, sqlalchemy to pyproject.toml
Create src/prediction_data/db/ directory
Create base.py with SQLAlchemy declarative base
Create session.py with async session factory
Add POSTGRES_* env vars to Settings
Verify postgres container starts and accepts connections

description: Create SQLAlchemy user model and migrations
steps: Create db/models/user.py with User model
Add password_hash, email, name, tier fields
Create watchlist and tracked_trader models
Add table creation script or alembic migration
Verify tables created in postgres
Create api/auth/ directory with router.py, service.py, schemas.py
Implement POST /auth/register - create user with hashed password
Implement POST /auth/login - verify password, return JWT
Implement POST /auth/refresh - refresh JWT
Implement GET /auth/me - return current user from JWT
Add python-jose, passlib[bcrypt] to pyproject.toml
Add JWT_SECRET, JWT_ALGORITHM to Settings

description: Add JWT validation middleware for protected routes
steps: Create get_current_user dependency in deps.py
Extract and validate JWT from Authorization header
Return 401 for missing/invalid tokens
Add optional get_current_user_optional for mixed routes
Verify protected endpoints require valid JWT
Configure FastAPI openapi metadata (title, version, description)
Add script to export openapi.json to repo root
Verify openapi.json contains all endpoints with schemas

description: Update frontend to use new backend auth
steps: Add proxy rewrite to next.config.js for /api/v1/*
Remove NextAuth configuration
Create auth context/store for JWT management
Update login page to call /api/v1/auth/login
Update register page to call /api/v1/auth/register
Store JWT in localStorage or httpOnly cookie
Add JWT to Authorization header on API calls

description: Set up OpenAPI to TypeScript type generation
steps: Add openapi-typescript to web/package.json
Add npm script to generate types from openapi.json
Generate initial types in web/src/lib/api/
Verify types match API schemas
